description: Encode the goal-brief rule that no session may begin while any gate is open. Supply either a structured `gates` list ([{ id, resolved }]) or a goal-brief `content` string, in which case the GATE LIST checkboxes (- [ ] / - [x]) are parsed. Returns { all_resolved, unresolved, may_begin } where may_begin === all_resolved. The server reads no files — the content is agent-supplied.

content.description: A goal-brief markdown string whose GATE LIST is parsed.

name: evaluate_gate
title: Evaluate whether a goal brief's gates are resolved
